svg.title: threads_per_warp = [8, 8]
svg.desc: One wave contains eight rows and eight columns of lanes. Each outlined lane contains two small value cells. The sixty-four lanes cover an eight-by-sixteen tensor tile, or one hundred twenty-eight values. Lane seventeen is at lane-grid row two column one.
svg.text: 8 rows × 8 columns of LANES. Each lane still owns 2 values.
Each outlined box is ONE lane; its two small cells are values.
